index.stand: Nordstrom.com's content framework was built from scratch, with its own names, icons, and typographic marks. | Content engagement lifted 22% over two years, and demand went up with it.
abs: Concepted the framework and pitched it to merchandising, marketing, and editorial.

Every story had to land.t: Every story had to land in one of four sections,
Every story had to land.g: from new arrivals and trending brands to occasion dressing
li: Wear to Where | occasion-based items and looks.
One typeface | every mark shared it, and each section got its own recognizable icon.

Every homepage module and email section.t: Whole landing pages were built around a single section of the framework,
